text: The Zorblax Pocket Widget clicks neatly and fits beside my keys.
My Nebula Dial arrived blue, turned smoothly, and was simple to set up.
The Quasar Clip held two notes all afternoon but felt a little stiff.
I could not understand the Comet Knob guide, though the gadget still worked.
The Orbit Tuner looks cheerful but makes an annoying chirp every hour.
